class X11Workspace:

    def __init__(self, default_readers=('producer', 'consumer')):
        self.default_readers = set(default_readers)
        self.files = {}

        self.events = []

        self.events.append(('permissions', identity, frozenset(allowed)))

        allowed, content = self.files[identity]
